# CheckNumber Telegram Number Checker API
> Official integration context generated from the checked API expansion manifest.

## Canonical resources
- [tg](https://docs.checknumber.ai/telegram-bulk-number-checker)
- [tg_active](https://docs.checknumber.ai/telegram-activity-checker)
- [tg_avatar](https://docs.checknumber.ai/telegram-bulk-number-checker-avatar)

## Contract facts
- API base URL: https://api.checknumber.ai
- Authentication: `X-API-Key` request header
- API key environment variable: `CHECKNUMBER_API_KEY`
- Processing mode: async_bulk
- Current prices are not embedded; use the official pricing page.

## Products
- `tg`: Number Checker · input `phone` · fields: number, activated
- `tg_active`: Activity Checker · input `phone` · fields: number, activated, uid, username, lastseen, activedays, member
- `tg_avatar`: Profile Checker · input `phone` · fields: Phone, activated, uid, username, Gender, Age, Ethnicity, Avatar, Last Online Time, Active Days, Is Member, first_name, last_name

## Safety
- Process only identifiers you are authorized to verify.
- Do not expose API keys in browser code or commit secrets.
- An undetermined result is not a confirmed negative.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-18.
